items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 35th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 72 while the rest average 40 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 72/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: 2.31M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-09-08: 29 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 2.31M SPX, 1.8σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 29 wallets left 2.31M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".
